name: Dmitry Fursov
title: Unity Developer
employment: Open to full-time, part-time and contract work
summary: Unity generalist working across gameplay, VR/AR, networking and UI. Building interactive products since 2019, with commercial experience in Unity/C# and frontend development. Delivered VR projects as the sole developer and contributed to a mobile RTS, industrial training simulators and AR applications.

pages.context: Industrial VR training simulations | Unity, C#, Meta Quest
bullets: Develop training and examination scenarios for Meta Quest 2 / 3S / 3, including step-by-step operations, action validation, hints, error logging and completion conditions.
Implemented training and examination modes with automatic sequence validation, error tracking and scenario restart; VR interactions reduced incorrect user actions by approximately 30%.
Moved recurring mechanics to ScriptableObject and reusable components, reducing duplicated code by approximately 25-30% and making new training operations about 1.5x faster to add.

pages.context: Mobile RTS and multiplayer | Unity, C#, Mirror, PlayFab
bullets: Designed client-server PvP interaction on Mirror and implemented battle replay storage and playback with network latency around 80-120 ms.
Optimized pathfinding AI for large battles, reducing computational iterations by approximately 50-60% and CPU load by 30-40% during simultaneous unit movement.
Built tournaments, game events, rewards and push notifications with Firebase, PlayFab and Azure Functions; also delivered gameplay mechanics for a mobile RTS and Vulkan Verse.

pages.context: MyChess, MyChessVR and drilling VR simulator | Unity, C#, Netcode
bullets: Solely delivered MyChessVR: classic chess, puzzles, Stockfish training, IK interactions, avatar lipsync, three locations and additive scene loading.

Independently built a drilling VR simulator demo with industrial equipment interaction and cooperative sessions on Netcode for GameObjects, OpenXR and XR Interaction Toolkit, synchronizing actions with latency up to 100 ms.
During frontend phases, developed MyChess with React/TypeScript and a Flutter mobile client; realtime product experience complemented the networked gameplay work.
Solely delivered the core functionality of an industrial VR simulator on Unigine/C#, including client-server architecture, multiplayer, examination logic, avatars and VOIP.
Implemented training and operator modes with real-time action monitoring; all training sessions stored results and completion history.
Synchronized equipment and user actions with latency below 80 ms, integrated custom VOIP and adapted the solution for HTC VIVE Pro, SteamVR and Astra Linux.

pages.context: Mobile AR applications | Unity, Vuforia, OpenCV, Photon
bullets: Designed on-demand 3D content delivery through AssetBundles with caching and version control, reducing the client build size by approximately 4x.
Developed commercial AR applications for Android and iOS with Unity/Vuforia, interactive projection systems with Unity/OpenCV and networked interactions with Photon.

education: Donetsk National University | Computer Science and Engineering. Bachelor's degree, 2020; Master's degree, 2023.
languages: Russian - native; English - B1; Ukrainian - B2.
